title: The Prince of Liechtenstein walked up to a UFO in the mountains

tellings.quote: that in and Lawrence told us that you know because he said that's why he was so convinced that it was true that his friend who was the prince of Likenstein had seen one

plain: The Prince of Liechtenstein, ruler of the small European country, is said to have walked up to a UFO somewhere in the mountains. The lawyer Dan Sheehan says the wealthy philanthropist Laurance Rockefeller told him and the Harvard psychiatrist John Mack about it. Rockefeller supposedly said his friend the prince's sighting was the reason he was so sure UFOs were real.
